title: File:Rohingya refugees protesting at Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh.jpg
desc: "The Rohingya refugees rallying at Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, on Aug. 25, 2023, demanded rights such as dignified repatriation, citizenship and legal employment."

desc: Rohingya Camp in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh

title: File:Rohingya refugees gathered on Genocide Remembrance Day.jpg
desc: "Around 6,000 Rohingya refugees gathered in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh, on the sixth International Rohingya Genocide Remembrance Day to demand and pray for their refugee rights."

title: File:Ambassador Miller visited Rohingya Refugee Camps in Cox's Bazar (45642490724).jpg
desc: U.S. Ambassador, Earl R. Miller, visited several Rohingya refugee camps and Bangladesh host communities during a December 4-6 trip to Cox’s Bazar. He emphasized that it is Myanmar’s responsibility to address the root causes of the refugee crisis, including providing the Rohingya access to citizenshi
